trial_design: randomized, two-arm parallel trial (supragingival therapy group vs intensive therapy group)
funding_source: Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo – FAPESP, São Paulo, Brazil, under protocol numbers 2011/06982-4;10057-4;18618-5
notes: Sample size calculation assumed 2 mm reduction in mean pocket depth (SD 0.6 mm) in IT group and 1 mm reduction (SD 0.6 mm) in ST group, with 90% power and 5% significance level, requiring 11 per group; 12 recruited per group to account for dropouts. Authors declare no conflict of interest.

trial_design: open-label, randomized clinical trial with four groups (T2DM tooth extraction only, T2DM tooth extraction + FM-SRP, non-diabetic tooth extraction only, non-diabetic tooth extraction + FM-SRP)
funding_source: Slovenian Human Resources Development and Scholarship Fund (SHRDSF)
notes: A priori sample size calculation was performed: effect size d=0.5, alpha error probability 0.08, power 0.8, resulting in 26 patients per group. Authors declare no conflict of interest. Study registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02874963). Described as a 'preliminary report'.

trial_design: randomized, parallel-control study with three arms (treatment group 1, treatment group 2, and control group) with 1:1:1 allocation
funding_source: Key Projects in the National Science and Technology Pillar Program in the Eleventh 5-Year Plan Periods, Beijing, China (Grant 2007 BAI 18 B 02) and the Science and Technology Planning Project of Guangdong Province, China (Grant 2010B031600117)
notes: Study was underpowered; sample size calculation assumed ~53 patients per group for 80% power but only 41-43 per group were analysed. Authors note this as an important limitation. No conflicts of interest declared.

setting: hospital outpatients, university dental hospital, general medical and dental practices
trial_design: 12 month, single-centre, parallel-group, investigator-masked, randomised trial
funding_source: Diabetes UK (grants 08/0003594 and 08/0003741) and UK National Institute for Health Research Biomedical Research Centre at University College London/University College London Hospitals
notes: Sample size calculated to detect a 1 percentage point difference in HbA1c (SD 2.1) with α=0.05 and 95% power assuming 10% loss to follow-up, requiring minimum 129 participants per group. Authors declare no competing interests. Study was retrospectively registered on ISRCTN registry on June 18, 2010.

setting: dental college hospital, medical college hospital
trial_design: prospective, randomized, parallel arm, double-centered clinical trial
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size estimated at ≥15 patients per group to achieve 90% power to detect mean difference between groups (p<0.05). Authors note limitations: small sample size, lack of nondiabetic control group, block randomization may introduce selection bias. Conflict of interest: None.

trial_design: A prospective, single-blinded, randomized controlled clinical trial of 88 patients aged 40–70 years was conducted on two parallel groups with three-month follow-up period
funding_source: This clinical trial was funded by the authors.
notes: Sample size calculated based on HbA1c primary outcome, requiring 42 patients per group (80% power, 95% confidence level), totalling 88 to account for dropout. Authors declare no conflicts of interest. Limitations noted include short follow-up period and sample size.

setting: outpatient medical and dental clinics, academic medical centers, community
trial_design: 6-month, single-masked, multicenter, randomized clinical trial
funding_source: National Institute of Dental and Craniofacial Research, National Institutes of Health (cooperative agreements grants U01 DE018902 and U01 DE018886)
notes: Enrollment was stopped early because of futility (conditional power threshold of 40%; observed t-test statistic was −0.37). Sample size calculation assumed 0.6% (SD 2%) reduction in HbA1c with 90% power; planned sample size was 600 (300 per group) assuming 20% attrition. Conflicts of interest declared by several authors including consulting relationships with pharmaceutical companies and the American Diabetes Association.

trial_design: multi-site, single-blind, randomized, controlled clinical trial with a two by two design
funding_source: Department of Veterans Affairs Health Services Research & Development Service, Career Development Program, VA HSR&D QUERI DII 99.206, NIH K24 DE00419, and Boston University
notes: Study was underpowered (165 participants enrolled vs. 300 planned). Power calculation: 300 participants planned, 200 expected after 33% attrition, 80% power to detect ES δ=0.40. No conflicts of interest stated. Authors note few women due to VA patient population.

trial_design: randomized controlled trial allocated patients via computer randomization into the treatment group consisting on scaling and root planing and oral hygiene instructions or the control group which only received oral hygiene instructions
funding_source: National Institutes of Health Clinical and Translational Award ULI RR024148 and KL2 RR024149 from the National Center For Research Resources
notes: Sample size calculated based on primary outcome HbA1c; 77 patients per group (including 20% attrition) required for 90% power with two-sided α=0.05. Authors declare no conflict of interests. Dietary choices and daily physical activities were not assessed. Population was low socioeconomically disadvantaged Hispanic individuals, limiting generalizability.

setting: community health services, correctional facilities, hospital
trial_design: parallel-group, randomized, open-label trial
funding_source: National Health and Medical Research Council: Project grant #627100; National Heart Foundation of Australia Future Leader Fellowship #100419; University of Adelaide Divisional Scholarship
notes: This is a secondary/subgroup analysis of the PerioCardio RCT (primary endpoint: cardiovascular disease markers), limited to 62 participants with type 2 diabetes out of 273 enrolled. Post hoc power calculation showed only 19% power for the HbA1c outcome with n=62; 398 participants would be required for adequate power. Authors declare no conflict of interest.

setting: university hospital dental and medical clinics
trial_design: Multi-center intervention study; 49 subjects randomly allocated to either the periodontal treatment (intervention) or non-periodontal treatment (control) groups by the envelope method, distributed as 2 in the intervention group and 1 in the control group.
funding_source: Grants-in Aid from the Ministry of Health and Welfare of Japan (H16-Iryo-020) and the Mitsui Sumitomo insurance foundation.
notes: No conflict of interest declared. 63 patients recruited, 49 fulfilled inclusion criteria and were randomized (32 intervention, 17 control). No sample-size calculation reported.

trial_design: Subjects were randomly assigned into two groups as treatment and non-treatment (control) groups.
funding_source: NR
notes: The examining investigator was unaware of group assignments. Patients who required surgical treatment had their data excluded from statistical analysis. No sample size calculation reported. No conflict of interest statement present.

trial_design: randomized controlled trial with treatment and no-treatment groups, further stratified by glycemic control, with a nondiabetic comparator group
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size calculated based on expected mean difference in HbA1c of ~0.4% and SD of 0.4, requiring at least 22 patients per group (90% power, two-sided type I error 5%). Nine patients withdrew after 3 months and were included in intention-to-treat analysis using last observation carried forward. No systemic inflammatory markers (e.g. TNF-α, IL-6) were measured, which is noted as a limitation.

trial_design: randomized, parallel-design, double-blinded, controlled clinical trial
funding_source: Health Promotion Fund, Ministry of Health and Welfare, Republic of Korea (#13-15)
notes: Sample size estimated at 72 patients (alpha=0.05, power=0.80, effect size=0.40, dropout rate=10%); 75 randomized, 60 analyzed (20 per group); no conflict of interest declared.

trial_design: randomized, controlled clinical trial, two-arm (intervention group and control group), parallel, examiner-blinded
funding_source: European National Fund and National Resources (EPEAEK 2 PYTHAGORAS)
notes: Sample size calculation based on expected mean difference in A1C reduction of ~0.4%, requiring at least 19 patients per group (90% power, two-sided alpha 5%). Authors acknowledge small sample size and potential selection bias. No conflicts of interest declared.

trial_design: single-masked, parallel-design, single center, randomized clinical trial
funding_source: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare: 25110601
notes: Sample size estimated assuming ≥0.8% (SD 0.8%) reduction in HbA1c; 17 subjects per group required for 80% power (alpha 0.05); planned sample size 40 (20 per group) assuming 15% attrition. No competing interests declared.

trial_design: 6-month, single-masked, randomized clinical trial with two parallel groups (treatment group vs. control group)
funding_source: No external funding, apart from the support of the authors' institution; research grant from SEPA; research grant from the University of Barcelona
notes: Sample size calculation: 36 patients per group needed (80% power, α=5%); 20% dropout rate assumed, so 48 assigned to CG and 42 to TG. Intention-to-treat analysis used. More smokers in TG than CG (p=.02). No conflicts of interest declared.

trial_design: A parallel group, three-arm randomized controlled trial
funding_source: Higher Education Commission of Pakistan through their National Research Program for Universities (NRPU) Grants [Grant No: 7143]
notes: Minimum sample size determined was n=105 (35 per group); raised to 150 to account for 40% attrition. Large number of drop-outs at follow-up noted as a major weakness. Investigators did not systematically record reasons for loss to follow-up. COVID-19 lockdown caused three participants to miss their last follow-up visit. Authors declare no conflict of interest.

trial_design: randomised clinical trial with 2 parallel arms (NSPT vs OHI)
funding_source: University of Malaya Research grants P0027/2009B and RG344/11
notes: Sample size calculation: 15 subjects per arm needed for 80% power to detect 1% change in HbA1c; 20 per arm recruited to compensate for dropouts. Trial not double-blinded; authors declare no conflicts of interest.

trial_design: randomized controlled clinical trial with three arms (two treatment groups and one control group)
funding_source: none declared
notes: No sample size calculation reported. No change in diabetic medication or diet was made for any patient during the study. The study was approved by the college ethical committee.

trial_design: single center double-blind with two parallel-groups, randomized controlled trial with a follow-up of 6 months
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size calculation: minimum 68 participants per group to detect HbA1c difference of 0.5% between groups at 5% significance level (two-sided two-sample z-test), 80% power, 20% drop-out rate. Authors declare no conflict of interest.

trial_design: randomized two-group parallel trial (T2DM-NT and T2DM-T) without blinding
funding_source: Zhejiang Science and Technology Projects (2009C33168), Natural Science Foundation of Zhejiang Province (Y2100077), Zhejiang Education Committee Projects (Y201017607), National Natural Science Foundation of China (30872884) and Zhejiang Health Bureau Fund (2009A104)
notes: 33 patients dropped out and were excluded from baseline data. The study was not blinded. Elderly persons, obese subjects, and those with several diabetic complications were excluded, limiting generalizability. Authors declare no conflict of interest.

trial_design: single blinded randomized controlled trial, 2-arm parallel design (treatment group vs control group with delayed periodontal treatment)
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size calculation: 14 subjects per arm needed for 90% power to detect a minimum 1% difference (SD 0.8) in HbA1c; 17 per arm recruited to account for dropout. No inflammatory markers measured. Long-term effects not determined. Authors declare no competing interests.

trial_design: randomized controlled clinical trial with 3 parallel arms; both examiner and participants were blinded
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size of 15 per group estimated from pilot study (α=0.05, β=0.2); 20 recruited per group to account for attrition; all 60 completed the study. Limitations include small sample size, no plasma inflammatory marker measurement, follow-up only 3 months, and drug dosage not recorded.

trial_design: randomized controlled trial with two parallel arms (intervention group and control group) with a 1:1 allocation ratio
funding_source: Xiamen Health Bureau (grant number: WSK 2012-01) and the National Institute of Hospital Administration (the hierarchical medical treatment policy in diabetes project)
notes: Authors declare no conflict of interest. Study limitations include elderly subjects only and short 3-month follow-up period. Single examiner used for all periodontal examinations.

setting: university teaching hospital (Diabetology and Dental Health Departments)
trial_design: prospective, open-labelled, randomized controlled clinical trial with two parallel groups (immediate vs. delayed periodontal treatment) and a follow-up of 3 months
funding_source: French Ministry of Health Clinical Research Hospital Program '2008' (Programme Hospitalier de Recherche Clinique inter-régional 0803108 [PHRCI]); equipment provided by ACTEON® Group; part-time staff financed by Oral-B France
notes: Sample size calculation based on detection of 0.5% change in HbA1c, SD of 1.0%, two-sided test at 5% significance level, 64 participants per group for 80% power; initial target 150 participants (75 per centre). Trial stopped early for futility after interim analysis showed conditional power below 35% and effect size close to null. Majority of participants had type 1 diabetes (~70%). No conflicts of interest declared.

setting: university hospital clinic (Prince Philip Dental Hospital and Queen Mary Hospital)
trial_design: Randomized controlled trial with two arms (Treatment group and Control group), restricted randomization at 3:2 ratio, examiner-blinded
funding_source: Hong Kong Research Grants Council (GRF No. HKU 768411M and 17155216) and Modern Dental Laboratory/HKU Endowment Fund
notes: Sample size calculated using G*Power 3.0 based on array dataset (fold change in log2 scale: IL-6, −2.11 ± 1.44; IL-8, −1.33 ± 0.58), at significance level 0.05 with 80% power. Authors declared no conflict of interest. Study described as preliminary due to small sample size; only 4 of 11 Treatment group patients selected for PCR array analysis.

trial_design: single-blind, randomized, controlled clinical trial
funding_source: "11th Five-Year" National Science and Technology Support Project (2007BAI18B02)
notes: Sample size calculated using PASS software based on a preliminary trial of 10 patients; 80% statistical power required 20 control and 40 treatment patients. No conflicts of interest declared. Randomization ratio 2:1 (treatment:control) to increase treatment group sample size.

trial_design: Randomized two-group controlled trial: group A (non-surgical periodontal treatment) and group B (temporarily without periodontal treatment); both groups received systemic doxycycline
funding_source: NR
notes: Authors note the small sample size (46 patients, 23 per group) as a limitation: 'Because of the small number of subjects included in this trial, it is quite likely that this study is insufficient to definitely show the differences which may actually exist.' Assessment made prior to and 16 weeks following therapy.
